thesis: The single most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is guiding users through the coverage and qualification process to view and select internet plans. This mechanism is bleeding value because critical forms are unusable, with evidence showing they "render without visible input fields or labels," and mobile usability is severely hampered as "every tap target [is] too small" due to a missing responsive viewport, collectively preventing users from completing essential steps.

findings.title: Weak Security Headers
findings.summary: Three of six standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.problem: 3 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Slow Script Load
findings.summary: The homepage loads 65 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.problem: The homepage loads 65 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Audit third-party tags, defer non-critical scripts, and remove duplicated analytics or marketing pixels.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 33 inline and 32 external <script> tags, 403 KB of HTML.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No Responsive Viewport
findings.summary: Mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small and hindering interaction.
findings.problem: Without a viewport meta tag mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small.
findings.evidence: Measured on the mobile render: no <meta name="viewport"> present.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Unusable Coverage Forms
findings.summary: Critical coverage and qualification forms are unusable because they lack visible input fields or labels, preventing user interaction.
findings.problem: Critical forms (coverage check, qualification) are unusable because they lack visible input fields or labels, preventing user interaction.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CONTINUE; notes: Implement visible input fields (e.g., address/ZIP) and labeled answer options (e.g., radio buttons) for all forms to enable user interaction.
findings.evidence: form: inputs=0 submit=CONTINUE labels=[] | form: inputs=0 submit=CONTINUE labels=[] | h1: What Best Describes Your Time on the Road? | h1: How Do You Use the Internet at Home? | form: inputs=0 submit=CONTINUE labels=[]
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Fragmented Plan Paths
findings.summary: Identical plan content across multiple URLs fragments the user journey and obscures the canonical next step.
findings.problem: Identical plan content across multiple URLs fragments the user journey and obscures the canonical next step.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Consolidate to a single canonical plans URL and implement 301 redirects for duplicates to unify the funnel.
findings.evidence: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet | h1: What Best Describes Your Time on the Road? | h2: The Fastest Rural & On-the-Go Internet in the USA
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Duplicate CONTINUE Buttons
findings.summary: Multiple identical 'CONTINUE' buttons on the same page create confusion, forcing users to guess the correct action.
findings.problem: Multiple identical 'CONTINUE' buttons on the same page, without distinguishing labels, create confusion and force users to guess the correct action.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CONTINUE; notes: Consolidate duplicate 'CONTINUE' forms or clearly label each button with its specific purpose (e.g., 'Check Home Coverage').
findings.evidence: form: inputs=0 submit=CONTINUE labels=[] | form: inputs=0 submit=CONTINUE labels=[]
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing Trust Signals
findings.summary: Key pages lack visible social proof, explicit guarantees, or security badges, undermining user confidence at critical decision points.
findings.problem: Key pages lack visible social proof (review context), explicit guarantees, or security badges, undermining user confidence at critical decision points.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Enhance review context, add clear money-back guarantees on relevant pages, and display recognizable security badges near pricing and CTAs.
findings.evidence: 4.3 stars from 9,200+ Google reviews | SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE | CHECK COVERAGE | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Inefficient Funnel Order
findings.summary: Requiring a coverage check before presenting plan options adds an unnecessary step, potentially increasing drop-off.
findings.problem: Requiring a coverage check before presenting plan options adds an unnecessary step, potentially increasing drop-off.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: SEE PLANS; notes: Reorder the funnel to present plan options first, then integrate coverage verification as a subsequent confirmation step.
findings.evidence: ctas: CHECK COVERAGE | CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS | SEE MY OPTIONS | GET STARTED | START CHAT | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE | ctas: CHECK COVERAGE | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Confusing CTA Options
findings.summary: Multiple equally prominent calls to action on each page dilute user focus and create ambiguity about the intended next step.
findings.problem: Multiple equally prominent calls to action on each page dilute user focus and create ambiguity about the intended next step.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Let's Get You the Right Internet; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Designate one clear primary CTA per page and visually demote secondary actions to improve focus.
findings.evidence: ctas: CHECK COVERAGE | CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS | SEE MY OPTIONS | GET STARTED | START CHAT | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE | ctas: CHECK COVERAGE | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Inaccessible Controls
findings.summary: Five interactive controls lack accessible names, making them unusable for screen reader and voice control users.
findings.problem: 5 of 46 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Give every control a visible text label or an aria-label. WCAG 2.2 AA, success criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 5 of 46 <button> elements contain no text content and no aria-label.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift
